journey.name: Undo stays on screen when new mail arrives
journey.description: Start: the Mailflare v2 inbox is open in Chrome and signed in, online, with at least two conversations in the list. New mail is delivered from the computer through the server's email handler (README.md, "Deliver test mail"), with a subject no earlier message had. While a v2 list is on screen, new mail reloads it over the realtime connection; that reload must leave the message on screen alone, including its Undo button (#48).

actions.action: Swipe the first conversation row from the left edge of the screen towards the right edge
Verify that a message reading "Conversation archived." with an "Undo" button appears near the bottom of the screen and that row is no longer in the inbox list
On the computer, deliver a new message to support@example.com with a new subject
Verify that within 8 seconds the new message appears at the top of the inbox list without the page reloading, and that the "Conversation archived." message with its "Undo" button is still shown
Verify that the archived conversation is back in the inbox list
